overall: All 11 requirements (FR-FLOW-022..032) are a FULL intent match: every SHALL clause and every AC is actually realized in the skill instruction text such that an agent can execute the described behavior — not merely keyword presence. Deep-read verification was done on the claude canonical bodies (kiwi-srs §0.20/§5.1-5.4/§9.6, kiwi-pipeline §2.5-2.7/§6.6/§7, kiwi-wave-master §3-§8, kiwi-planner Official Workflow Tool Policy/§6.8, _shared/kiwi/auto-option.md §2-§3) and cross-checked to codex/etc via the identical bilingual content-assertion suite plus spot-checks. The specific intent-drift risks flagged in the task are all correctly encoded: FR-FLOW-024 -qna unbounded loop + --auto->committee suppression + end-signal auto-decision + 3-subagent docs/research; FR-FLOW-030 OQ-030 structure guard's BOTH branches (structured research-skip vs unstructured wave-split fallback); FR-FLOW-032 full ladder (reconcile -> one-by-one -> 2 sequential + persistent marking -> --max refuter/AC-granularity -> omission-repair -> 2x-zero termination); FR-FLOW-025 3/5/7 ladder + lead-#1 tie-break.
